policy.active_support_rule: status is CURRENT and numerical qualifies is true
policy.contrast_target_rule: after a sample-label correction, the current top-ranked gene with fold change at least 2.0 has current finding SUPPORTED, is the validation target, and licenses RUN_VALIDATION

evidence_status_vocabulary.WITHDRAWN_QC: withdrawn after quality-control failure; ineligible for active support

policy.history_rule: dated decisions retain the policy effective when made
policy.independence_rule: condition-specific sample sets must be disjoint

qualification.meaning: numerical qualification of the contrast result; independent of current/withdrawn status
